newsitem.title: USA: Atlas sees more normal operations in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Atlas sees more normal operations in Q4.

text.p: Atlas Air Inc said Monday is expects to return to "more normalized operations" in the fourth quarter after posting $2.6 million in third quarter charges to add new aircraft to its fleet.
As part of its fleet growth plan, Atlas said it has taken delivery of four freighter aircraft from Federal Express and the first of six aircraft being acquired from Thai Airways.
At the request of Federal Express, Atlas said it deferred delivery of one Federal Express aircraft until the first quarter of 1997.
Atlas is preparing for the delivery of the five remaining aircraft from Thai Air through 1997, and is looking to further expand its fleet starting in 1998.
The carrier said it expects to meet its business plan for the balance of the year.
It confirmed the renewal of a key British Airways Plc contract but declined to comment on the value of the pact.
